outcome.technical:
Fixes BUG-22. Rendered from this repository's own plan, the report scrolled sideways at 833-1512px. The cause was not the phase summary. It was a `span.ptev` evidence chip with `white-space:nowrap` whose text is an accepted commit's free-text reason (`accepted <sha>: <reason>`), so one unbreakable line widened table.phases.

The fix is three rules, covering the class:
- tables.css: `:where(table.phases,table.data) td[colspan]{overflow-wrap:anywhere}` at every width.
- tables.css: plain-text cells (`td:not([class]):not(:has(*))`) wrap, above the 52rem breakpoint only. Below it the table already scrolls inside its own frame, and wrapping there split words mid-letter when measured.
- badges.css: `.ptev:not(:has(*)){white-space:normal}` lets a plain-text chip wrap, while chips built from pills or counts keep nowrap. The redundant `.ptev[data-fullrun]` rule is removed.

Pin css2's label and clauses now say this, and they tie the full-run claim to the rendered markup.

Regression cases live in tools/check-report-interactive.mjs, so every report it checks is covered:
- For each phases/data table, it plants copies of the table's first row carrying a very long summary and an unbroken token, plus a plain-text chip and a token chip. At every width on the ladder, it compares the page's scroll width with and without them.
- A second check fails if the planted rows never painted or never wrapped.

Red-first: the helper's verdict is could-not-prove, because playwright is missing in its throwaway tree (verbatim in the return). The orchestrator re-ran the executor's probe, scratchpad P120.1/mut.py: exit 0, with each of the three rules removed on its own turning the case red, and a detached or unpainted planting turning the second check red. A css2 mutation probe turns the pin red three ways.

Followers re-rendered in the same commit, so the committed pages carry the fix: examples/report.sh, docs/index.html as its byte copy, docs/demo-large.html, and the screenshots.

Fresh renders of this repo's plan and the demo pass the browser checker.
outcome.descriptive: The report no longer scrolls sideways on a plan with long free text, at any width, and the browser check now plants hostile content in every report it checks to keep it that way.

intentCheck.basis: orchestrator check: cause located (a nowrap evidence chip), class fixed with three rules; probe re-run, each rule removed turns the case red; followers re-rendered
